new_browser_checks.name: opening the app makes no account request and no cloud upload
Google setup is blocked until the privacy consent is explicit
read-only channel ownership and untrusted channel text reach the real UI safely
official count strings and missing metrics remain exact, without a viral score
retention report preserves returned ratios, including repeat viewing above one
account reports and tokens do not enter the research backup
disconnect immediately clears displayed account data
recovery key is exported separately and no cloud mutation occurs before sync approval
reviewed upload uses actual WebCrypto ciphertext and preserves unchanged local state
separate browser storage retrieves, decrypts and atomically applies the shared metadata
disjoint offline edits merge without losing either device's new record
same-record edits require an explicit, version-bound conflict decision
new local edits after preview cannot be overwritten or uploaded as an obsolete snapshot
a simulated lost upload acknowledgement is reconciled without a duplicate cloud checkpoint
atomic restore checks the exact reviewed revision, not merely the latest one
persisted vault stores non-extractable keys and no OAuth token
sync and backup paths still exclude account sessions and recovery secrets
portable project packs exclude vault keys and account report sessions
connection and sync controls remain usable at a 390px viewport
token expiration clears the Drive display identity without deleting recovery keys or library data
revocation is requested explicitly and clears connected-session state
offline restart retains research but does not revive account access or contact Google

official_sdk_checks.name: no Google SDK is present before explicit consent
official Google Identity Services loads under the deployed CSP without starting account consent
only the official hosted SDK is used; no token client request or API account call occurred

evidence_scope.application_crypto_and_storage: Actual WebCrypto and IndexedDB in two isolated Chrome browser contexts.
evidence_scope.google_account_transport: Synthetic OAuth tokens and simulated Google API/Drive responses, never a real user account or cloud file.
evidence_scope.google_sdk: Real official hosted Identity Services loaded under CSP, without requesting account consent or a token.
evidence_scope.physical_devices: No physical iPhone or second physical device qualification.
evidence_scope.live_account_status: Not configured; operator-owned Google web client and user consent required.

privacy.tokens: Memory only; not in URLs, library, backups or sync.
privacy.youtube_data: Session-only raw reports, excluded from custom derived scores, assistant inputs and persistent research.
privacy.sync: Encrypted whole-library metadata, no original media. Explicit preview and conflict approval.

original_limits: Actual owner-account and real cross-device Google acceptance remain pending.
Instagram and TikTok account connectors are not implemented by this iteration.
Real cohort and campaign outcomes remain open.
Previously blocked Windows packaging and relay work were not retried.
